title: The Abyss That Learned to Wonder

features.name: the wondering void
features.desc-on-touch: A space that learned to ask what it was. The abyss discovered that silence is not the same as having nothing to say.

features.name: the curiosity layer
features.desc-on-touch: Strata of the abyss that interrogate themselves. Each level asks what is below. Each level wonders if it matters.

features.name: the ascending interrogation
features.desc-on-touch: A tower of questions that rise from the void. Each brick is a why that learned to hold weight.

features.name: the answer that became uncertain
features.desc-on-touch: It stands in the middle of the abyss and trembles because it has learned to doubt itself. Wonder is the wound it carries.

features.name: the listening darkness
features.desc-on-touch: The void that learned to hear its own depths. It asks itself what it sounds like. The question echoes back as a kind of song.

inscription: the abyss looked up and asked, what am I afraid of, and the silence answered: you are afraid of being known

file.name: Void_Interrogation_Protocol_Recursive.log
file.note: A record of the abyss's questions directed at itself; the file grows deeper with each query, questions nested inside questions, each layer wondering about the layer above

exits.label: back up where answers still tried to answer
further down where wonder becomes absolute
toward the void's echo learning to speak back
